name: Baheal Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Baheal Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, wholesale, and retail of pharmaceutical products in China, the United States, Hong Kong, and internationally. It offers bone health drugs under the D-Cal brand name; digestive drugs under the Mite brand name; respiratory and anti-infective drugs; and liver disease drugs under the Fuzhenghuayu brand name. The company also provides urological and ophthalmic drugs; anti-aging and cosmeceuticals drugs under the Quanis, Excellula, Transino, and Qingchunbao brand names; diabetes drugs under the Naida, Feburic, and Naite brand names; and medical nutrition under the Nutrasumma brand name.
